Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
The white-wolf site lists Aleister Crowley as group 4. Also, he is in
the Malkavian starter, which would lead one to believe that he is,
indeed, group 4. Is the official card list to be taken as errata to
the physical card, which says he is group 5?

Messages.Author: JH
Messages.Body:


As all the other precon vampires are indeed group 4 and with Aleister
counted as group 4 the number of Malkavians in group 4 matches with
other Camarilla clans, I'd presume that we have a case of misprint.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


It seems like it might be a minor enough misprint that LSJ will just
tell us to play him as written. Then again, maybe the card list
version is to be taken as errata... LSJ? It wouldn't necessarily be
a big deal if he were errata'd, as there are currently no group 6
vamps that he could play with as a group 5. So, it's not like someone
could build a deck that looks legal as he is printed but would be
illegal with him errata'd. Although, I'm assuming group 6 isn't all
that far away.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No errata; no misprint. He's group 5.
